value.name: 7' · Omer Atzili v Juventus
value.narrative: Pierre Cornud: Delivers the cross (ESPN, Irish Times, Times of Israel). Omer Atzili: Goes up for the cross but ducks; ball deflects in off his back (Times of Israel, Juventus.com). ESPN/Irish Times call it a header; recorded as a generic finish.

sequence.position: wide, flank not agreed between sources
sequence.note: Delivers the cross (ESPN, Irish Times, Times of Israel).
Goes up for the cross but ducks; ball deflects in off his back (Times of Israel, Juventus.com). ESPN/Irish Times call it a header; recorded as a generic finish.

goals.notes: ESPN and Irish Times (same wire wording): Cornud cross, Atzili header, Szczęsny scrambling. Times of Israel: Cornud cross, Atzili rose then ducked, ball struck his back. Juventus.com: cross from the right, ball off Atzili's back to the far post. Body part resolved to 'off his back' by two independent publishers; flank left unspecified (only Juventus.com says right), hence column C is a placeholder anchor. Played at Sammy Ofer Stadium; final 2-0.
